However, the policy clauses provided in the context do not contain the specific exclusions referenced by HLTH-COV-2.1, such as HLTH-EXC-4.1 regarding pre-existing conditions like osteoarthritis diagnosed in 2022. Because the necessary exclusion clauses are missing from the policy text to fully evaluate coverage, the claim requires human review by a senior handler.
